usage: dns-sd [--verbose] --global enumerate
       dns-sd [--verbose] --global browse [--timeout=NUMBER] [<type>][<domain>]
       dns-sd {--help | --version}

  -v, --verbose  
  -h, --help     Display this help screen then exit
      --version  Print the build version then exit

Operations:

  -g, --global {browse|enumerate}  Run an operation

         enumerate  Enumerate registration domains
         browse     Browse for services
